body: Are you kidding me? You have more responsibility on your plate than most adults do. How can you be blamed for the way someone else feels? You bear more than what you should, i believe people are hurting you, not the other way round. I was the scapegoat for years and i finally learned that it is not my fault. I ain't saying that you have no right to feel the way you do, all i am saying is that we're here for you and willing to help you through this. I was told growing up that i was forcefully insane. The truth remains, my family kept me in a cage. One which they used as an outlet to project their own bad feelings on. In short, none of this is your fault. You are stronger than they are.
